name: Feosii
source:
King of Jensina who made an arrangement with Akemi so he would marry one of his daughters in exchange of an alliance with Brunaria.
At first the young admiral refused the king's offer, but with the Enorean empire marching towards the nation, he had no choice but to accept the proposal.
